items.title: A Hausdorff space which is the closure of the image of a continuous map has cardinality at most the double power set of the source
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the cardinality bound for a Hausdorff space that is the closure of the image of a continuous map (author lemma at source lines 5322-5328, label lemma-dense-image): the target has cardinality at most that of the double power set of the source. The proof (source lines 5330-5345) is a real argument rather than a citation: it introduces the closed domains of the target, assigns to each point the closed domain cut out by the open neighbourhoods of the image containing it, and shows this assignment is injective using Hausdorffness to separate points (proof lines 5334-5344). The lemma is the cardinality input for the construction of the Stone-Cech compactification in this section. H2.
